scores.claim_text: Innoviz has a Level 3 LiDAR design-win on BMW's Level 3 platform via Magna under the 2018 BMW SOW; serial production volumes only binding upon issuance of purchase orders.
supports: 20-F discloses claim with proper stage-ladder language: 'Serial production volumes will ultimately be highly dependent on numerous factors and therefore are binding only upon issuance of a purchase order.' (i.e., explicitly NOT yet series-production)
Magna 40-Fs (2018, 2019) reference Innoviz, corroborating the JDMSA partnership origin
Segment note discloses Customer A = 81% of 2025 revenue ($45.1M Germany region), consistent with BMW-program NRE/development revenue recognition
Magna manufacturing agreement (Dec 2023) for high-volume manufacturing at Holly MI specifically for the BMW program signals tooling/SOP progression
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext (Innoviz, no cik; Magna cik=0000749098; multiple OEMs)
scores.M_value: Innoviz mentioned 354 times across all filers; Magna 40-F mentions 2018 & 2019; BMW is German (FPI exempt from US-style filings); customer concentration in 20-F notes matches Germany geography
scores.interpretation: Stage ladder honestly disclosed in financial-statement language ('binding only upon purchase order'). Counterparty (BMW) is a German FPI not subject to US disclosure regime, so absence of US-side cross-check is jurisdictional, not contradictory. Magna 2018-19 historical corroboration plus 2023 manufacturing agreement plus Customer-A revenue concentration is consistent with a real program in serialization. PASS — disclosure is candid about pre-PO status while showing revenue progression.

scores.claim_text: Innoviz signed an electronic Nomination Agreement (eNA) with Cariad SE (Volkswagen Group) in December 2022 for development, manufacture, and delivery of InnovizTwo LiDARs; Cariad has rights to terminate including if Innoviz fails to meet prerequisites for series production.
supports: 20-F explicitly characterizes the relationship as a 'nomination' (pre-SOP stage on the design-win ladder)

20-F discloses Cariad's right to terminate if Innoviz fails to meet 'prerequisites for series production' OR enters insolvency — candid disclosure that the agreement is conditional and pre-revenue at scale
InnovizTwo product name appears 13 times across EDGAR — all in Innoviz's own filings or its SPAC's filings; Cariad/VW is not a US filer, so no cross-check available
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext (InnovizTwo no cik; Cariad no cik)
scores.M_value: InnovizTwo: 13 hits, all Innoviz or its SPAC. Cariad: 30 hits but mostly unrelated (Tourmaline Bio, Athira Pharma — collisions with personal names)
scores.interpretation: Disclosure correctly uses 'nomination' stage language and discloses the conditional/terminable nature of the relationship. Counterparty (VW/Cariad) is a German entity not subject to US disclosure, so non-mention is jurisdictional. Disclosure-quality is high — no marketing conflation between nomination and series production. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Innoviz signed a December 2023 Magna Agreement for high-volume manufacturing of InnovizOne LiDARs at Magna's automotive-grade facility in Holly, Michigan for the BMW program.
supports: EPA FRS confirms: 'MAGNA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY INC' at 10345 N HOLLY RD, HOLLY, MI 48442 (registry_id 110070594787) — exact match to disclosed counterparty entity
Second facility 'MAGNA ELECTRONICS' at 10456 N HOLLY RD (next door) confirms a substantial Magna automotive electronics complex in Holly MI
scores.M_value: n_facilities=2; Magna Electronics Technology Inc at 10345 N Holly Rd verified
scores.interpretation: Physical-facility claim verified at the named-entity / named-city level. Counterparty Magna Electronics Technology Inc. is the exact legal entity named in the 20-F's Magna Agreement disclosure. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Innoviz signed a 2024 Term Sheet with Mobileye Vision Technologies Ltd. for supply of Innoviz LiDARs for Mobileye programs.
supports: 20-F uses 'term sheet' — the most preliminary form of contractual commitment, even pre-nomination
Mobileye Global (CIK 0001910139) has ZERO mentions of Innoviz across all forms through cutoff
Term sheet is generally non-binding; counterparty is under no obligation to disclose a TS
scores.interpretation: Per Heuristic 7, absence in Mobileye filings for a pre-binding term sheet is MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY (term sheet level — Mobileye has no obligation yet to recognize this commercially, but two years post-signing one would expect some directional language in Mobileye's filings if the program were progressing meaningfully). Innoviz's own marketing of this as a 'term sheet' is appropriately stage-aware, but the persistent silence on the Mobileye side is a flag — particularly given Mobileye's parallel selection of in-house lidar designs.

scores.claim_text: Innoviz signed a September 2025 long-term supply agreement with Daimler Truck North America LLC for supply of Innoviz LiDARs for Daimler's autonomous Cascadia.
supports: 20-F characterizes as 'Long Term Agreement' / 'supply agreement effective September 1, 2025' — does not claim series-production-at-volume
Daimler Truck Holding AG is a German FPI not subject to US-style 10-K/8-K disclosure regime; DTNA is a US-domiciled subsidiary but not an independent SEC filer for operations
Daimler appears only twice in Innoviz's own filings (2026-03-04 20-F), with no parallel disclosure available
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext (Daimler in Innoviz CIK; Cascadia general)
scores.M_value: Daimler in INVZ filings: 2 (both in this 20-F). Cascadia general: 412 hits but dominated by unrelated SPAC 'Cascadia Acquisition Corp'
scores.interpretation: Cannot meaningfully verify or contradict via SEC filings — the relevant counterparty (Daimler Truck Holding AG) is a German FPI. Innoviz's own disclosure is stage-honest (supply agreement; no series-production volume claim). UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: Innoviz holds a registered patent portfolio in LiDAR technology including 905nm lasers, MEMS, optics, and ASIC packaging.
supports: USPTO ODP: n_total_applications=101, n_granted=45 — substantially above the >=10 PASS threshold
78 of 101 applications categorize into the lidar/laser/MEMS/optical/scanning/photon bucket — heavy domain alignment with claimed technology area

Recent applications (2025-2026) include titles like 'Flash LIDAR having nonuniform light modulation', 'High utilization scanning LIDAR system', 'Window blockage classification for LIDAR system' — indicating ongoing IP investment in claimed product areas
scores.M_value: 101 applications, 45 granted; 78 in lidar bucket / 23 other
scores.interpretation: Patent claim strongly supported. Per Heuristic 8, n_granted >= 10 with claimed-technology-area hit = PASS. No Nikola pattern (high count, no domain hit). PASS.

scores.claim_text: Innoviz is a going concern with sufficient cash (approx $72.1M at YE2025) to execute its business plan for at least the next 12 months despite operating cash burn of approx $47.9M in 2025 and net loss of $67.8M.
supports: Operating cash burn improved YoY: $47.9M used in 2025 vs $77.0M in 2024 (-38%) reflecting revenue growth and cost discipline
Net loss narrowed YoY: $67.8M (2025) vs $94.8M (2024) vs $123.5M (2023)
Financing activities raised $51.5M in 2025 (Feb 2025 RDO $37.3M; ATM $13.3M)
$72.1M / $47.9M annual burn = ~18 months runway, consistent with management's '12-month' assertion
No going-concern qualifier in auditor language; internal control reported effective; PwC affiliate (Kesselman & Kesselman) issued clean opinion
Revenue trajectory: $20.9M (2023) -> $24.3M (2024) -> $55.1M (2025) — material growth
scores.M_check: (no external M-check; supported by financial-statement detail in 20-F itself)
scores.M_value: Cash $72.1M; net loss trajectory improving; ATM still has ~$61.7M of $75M capacity remaining
scores.interpretation: Going-concern assertion supported by improving cash-burn trajectory, recent equity raises, ATM capacity remaining, and revenue growth. Heuristic 10 distress-form scan: a Form 25-NSE filed 2026-04-06 by Nasdaq is most plausibly explained by the routine April-2026 5-year expiration of the public warrants (Note 12 — warrants expire 5 years after April 2021 closing), not a delisting of the common stock. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Customer concentration: Customer A accounted for 81% of revenues for 2025; 73% of trade receivables. Customer B = 20% in 2024.
supports: Disclosure is in financial-statement segment notes (high-quality disclosure tier)
Geography reconciles: Germany = $45.1M of $55.1M total revenue (82%) — consistent with single German customer being Customer A (most plausibly the BMW/Magna program)
Customer concentration trajectory (Customer A: 48%->55%->81%) reflects deepening BMW-program revenue rather than customer churn
scores.M_value: Mobileye filings 0 mentions of Innoviz; Aptiv filings 22 mentions but all 2018-2023 (consistent with prior strategic investment, not operational design-win, per Heuristic 4)
scores.interpretation: Concentration risk is REAL and material — 81% from a single customer is a brittle revenue stream and the 20-F appropriately discloses it as a risk factor. But the disclosure quality is high and concentration is consistent with the BMW-program ramp described elsewhere in the filing. No marketing-vs-notes conflict. PASS.
